name: Pressure Advance Calibration
description: Generate a PA/LA test pattern for Klipper, Marlin, or RepRapFirmware. Supports presets for Voron, Bambu, and Prusa.

name: Retraction Calibration
description: Generate a retraction distance test tower for direct drive or Bowden setups. Finds your optimal retraction in one print.

name: Flow Rate Calculator
description: Calculate the volumetric flow rate your hotend must sustain. Shows which hotend tier your print settings require.

name: Print Cost Estimator
description: Calculate filament, electricity, and total cost per print job. Useful for quoting and material budgeting.

name: Filament Converter
description: Convert between filament weight and length for PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, PA-CF, and TPU at 1.75mm or 2.85mm.

name: PA Calculator
description: Map Pressure Advance values across a speed/acceleration grid. Import OrcaSlicer PA sweep results to auto-fill.

name: Pin Mapper
description: Quick-reference Klipper pin lookup for BTT Octopus, Manta M8P, SKR 3, Fysetc Spider, and LDO Leviathan.

name: Motor Simulator
description: Compare common Voron stepper motors at 24V or 48V. Usable current, estimated torque, and recommended use cases.

name: PA Tuner
description: AI-powered Pressure Advance analysis. Describe your setup, paste PA data or upload a test print photo for recommendations.
